title: Emulator measurement scenario
description: An ordered list of phases or building blocks (docs/SCENARIOS.md)

poll_s.title: Poll
poll_s.description: How often conditions and disruptions are evaluated while waiting

drain_s.title: Drain
drain_s.description: Packets sent in the last drain_s before an evaluation are not counted yet

min_samples.title: Samples
min_samples.description: Packets a window needs before a pdr, rtt or latency condition is decided

parent_min_dbm.title: Parent threshold
parent_min_dbm.description: Links at or below this level cannot carry a new parent: routers that would need them are not counted as repairable (the stack's DEVICE_MIN_SENS -93 dBm + CAND_PARENT_THRESHOLD 10 dB + hysteresis 3 dB)

load.title: Load
load.description: The application load from the start of the phase

flows.title: Flows
flows.description: up: routers to border router; down: border router to each router; mcast: border router to a group; p2p: router to router. Up, down and p2p are echoed

rate_pps.title: Rate
rate_pps.description: Offered packets per second of each flow, whole network

interval_s.title: Interval
interval_s.description: Instead of rate_pps: mean interval of each router (default 30 s)

max_rate_pps.title: Rate cap
max_rate_pps.description: With interval_s: at most this rate, whole network (a light probe whatever the network size)

echo.title: Echo
echo.description: Targets answer, so that originators measure the RTT

allOf.x-message: give one of rate_pps, interval_s and rate_of
max_rate_pps goes with interval_s, not rate_pps
max_rate_pps goes with interval_s, not rate_of

condition.title: Condition
condition.description: A condition on the run, evaluated live at each poll

is.title: Kind
is.description: immediately: true at once; time: virtual time reached; elapsed: time since the reference (the previous phase's end for a start, the phase's start for an end); formed: the network has joined; node_event: a node joined, changed or lost its parent, restarted; repaired: every router cut off by the last disruption that can be repaired has a route again; metric: a measured value compared with a threshold; all / any: a combination

t_s.title: Time
t_s.description: For time: virtual time since the run's start

fraction.title: Share of routers
fraction.description: For formed: the share of the routers (or of nodes) that must have joined

milestone.title: Milestone
milestone.description: For formed (default ready) and node_event joined (default operational): operational (Wi-SUN join done) or ready (RPL routing ready; not repeated when an interface comes back up)

stable_s.title: Stable for
stable_s.description: For formed: and no parent change anywhere for this long

e2e.title: End to end
e2e.description: For repaired: also every cut-off router is in the border router's routing table and got an echo for a packet sent after the disruption (when it takes part in an echoed flow)

op.title: Comparison
op.description: For metric. Default: "worse than" the value: >= for delays, queues, retries...; < for pdr, delivered_pps and joined_fraction

value.title: Value
value.description: For metric: the threshold, in the metric's unit (or relative_to instead)

per_hop.title: Per hop count
per_hop.description: For metric (rtt, latency): true if the comparison holds for any hop count, each against the same hop count of relative_to

flow.title: Flow
flow.description: For traffic metrics: the flow (default: up, else the first one running)

window_s.title: Window
window_s.description: For metric: the trailing window of packets sent

min_samples.title: Samples
min_samples.description: For pdr, rtt and latency metrics: at least this many packets in the window, else the condition is not decided yet (default: settings.min_samples)

allOf.x-message: a node_event condition needs event and nodes
a metric condition needs a metric and either value or relative_to (not both)

phase.title: Phase
phase.description: Start when [start]; set [load]; do [actions]; measure [measure]; end when [end] (or repeat)

name.title: Name
name.description: Unique name, used by later phases

start.title: Start
start.description: When the phase starts (default: right after the previous phase): a condition, with a timeout and what to do when it expires

timeout_s.title: Timeout
timeout_s.description: Give up waiting after this long

on_timeout.title: On timeout
on_timeout.description: start: start anyway (flagged in the result); skip: skip this phase; abort: end the scenario

allOf.x-message: a node_event condition needs event and nodes
a metric condition needs a metric and either value or relative_to (not both)

actions.title: Actions
actions.description: Done in order at the start, after the load

items.title: Action
items.description: Something done at the start of the phase, after the load is set

do.title: Action
do.description: kill: power off; restart: power off and a fresh start; leave: the interface goes down (a graceful leave); cut_links: every link of the nodes (or to peers) cut; partition: links between groups a and b cut; degrade_links: every link of the nodes at rssi_dbm; interferer_add, interferer_remove: external interference (central medium); mark: a note in the logs

for_s.title: For
for_s.description: Undo after this long: restart the killed nodes, interface up, links back, interferer removed. Omitted: permanent

name.title: Name
name.description: For interferer_add and interferer_remove ("all": every one)

label.title: Label
label.description: Name of the nodes this action picked, for later selections (select label)

oneOf.title: Load
oneOf.description: The application load from the start of the phase

load.title: Load
load.description: The load from this phase on: settings, "off", or "keep" (the default)

sets.title: Measurements
sets.description: Any of: traffic: Delivery, RTT and one-way delay overall and per hop count, offered and delivered throughput; queues: Per node: queue depths, drops, MAC retries and give-ups, channel-access failures; mesh: Topology: parents, depths, orphans, parent changes, RPL control messages; power: Per node: charge and average current in the phase, by state (needs POWER); medium: Frames, airtime and reception outcomes of the radio medium

settle_s.title: Settle
settle_s.description: Time after the start not measured

end.title: End
end.description: When the phase ends: after a fixed duration (after_s), or when a condition holds, with a cap (max_s). Default: after 60 s

is.description: immediately: true at once; time: virtual time reached; elapsed: time since the reference (the previous phase's end for a start, the phase's start for an end); formed: the network has joined; node_event: a node joined, changed or lost its parent, restarted; repaired: every router cut off by the last disruption that can be repaired has a route again; metric: a measured value compared with a threshold; all / any: a combination

repeat.title: Repeat
repeat.description: Iterations: the load changes at each, until a condition holds (a capacity search)

mul.title: Multiply
mul.description: The rate is multiplied by this at each iteration

add_pps.title: Add
add_pps.description: Instead of mul: the rate grows by this at each iteration

window_s.title: Window
window_s.description: Measured time of an iteration (made longer when the rate gives fewer than min_samples packets)

settle_s.title: Settle
settle_s.description: Time at the new load before the window

confirm.title: Confirm
confirm.description: The condition must hold on this many windows in a row at the same load

until.description: Stop when this holds on an iteration's measurements

allOf.x-message: give mul or add_pps, not both
a phase has end or repeat, not both

block_formed.title: Wait for the network
block_formed.description: Wait until the routers have joined (ready and in the border router's table) and no parent changed for stable_s

use.title: Block
use.description: Wait until the routers have joined (ready and in the border router's table) and no parent changed for stable_s

stable_s.title: Stable for
stable_s.description: No parent change for this long

timeout_s.title: Timeout
timeout_s.description: Start anyway after this long, flagged

block_probe.title: Per-hop RTT probe
block_probe.description: A light load, its RTT, delay and delivery per hop count: the baseline of later phases

use.title: Block
use.description: A light load, its RTT, delay and delivery per hop count: the baseline of later phases

rate_pps.title: Rate
rate_pps.description: Offered packets/s, whole network (default: one packet per router every 30 s, at most 0.5 packets/s)

flows.title: Flows
flows.description: up: routers to border router; down: border router to each router; mcast: border router to a group; p2p: router to router. Up, down and p2p are echoed

block_capacity.title: Capacity search
block_capacity.description: Raise the load step by step until the RTT reaches rtt_factor x the baseline's, the largest RTT max_rtt_ms, or the delivery falls below min_pdr (on confirm windows in a row); the capacity is the measured offered rate of the last step before

use.title: Block
use.description: Raise the load step by step until the RTT reaches rtt_factor x the baseline's, the largest RTT max_rtt_ms, or the delivery falls below min_pdr (on confirm windows in a row); the capacity is the measured offered rate of the last step before

baseline.title: Baseline phase
baseline.description: The phase whose RTT is the reference

start_rate_pps.title: First rate
start_rate_pps.description: Packets/s of the first step (default: 2 x the baseline's)

mul.title: Step factor
mul.description: Rate multiplied by this at each step

window_s.title: Window
window_s.description: Measured time of a step (longer when the rate gives too few packets)

settle_s.title: Settle
settle_s.description: Time at the new load before measuring

confirm.title: Confirm
confirm.description: The condition must hold on this many windows in a row at the same load

rtt_metric.title: RTT metric
rtt_metric.description: The RTT compared with the baseline

rtt_factor.title: RTT factor
rtt_factor.description: Saturated when the RTT reaches this x the baseline's

max_rtt_ms.title: RTT ceiling
max_rtt_ms.description: Saturated when the largest RTT reaches this

min_pdr.title: Delivery floor
min_pdr.description: Saturated when the delivery ratio falls below this

flows.title: Flows
flows.description: up: routers to border router; down: border router to each router; mcast: border router to a group; p2p: router to router. Up, down and p2p are echoed

block_interference.title: Interference
block_interference.description: An external interferer from the start of the phase, under a share of the capacity found; optionally first a reference at the same load without it (<name>_reference), the baseline of a recovery

use.title: Block
use.description: An external interferer from the start of the phase, under a share of the capacity found; optionally first a reference at the same load without it (<name>_reference), the baseline of a recovery

interferer_name.title: Interferer name
interferer_name.description: Its name, to remove it later

reference_s.title: Reference
reference_s.description: Before the interferer: this long measured at the same load without it, as the phase <name>_reference (0: none)

settle_s.title: Settle
settle_s.description: Not measured at the start (of the reference too)

block_recovery.title: Recovery
block_recovery.description: Remove the interferer (if any) at the same load and measure until the RTT is back near the baseline

use.title: Block
use.description: Remove the interferer (if any) at the same load and measure until the RTT is back near the baseline

interferer_name.title: Interferer name
interferer_name.description: The interferer removed ("all": every one; "": none)

within.title: Back within
within.description: Ends when the RTT p95 is at most this x the baseline's

block_node_failure.title: Node failure
block_node_failure.description: Power off nodes (default: the hop-1 router with the largest subtree) under a share of the capacity, and measure until the mesh is repaired

use.title: Block
use.description: Power off nodes (default: the hop-1 router with the largest subtree) under a share of the capacity, and measure until the mesh is repaired

label.title: Label
label.description: Name of the failed nodes, for a later restart

capacity_phase.title: Capacity phase
capacity_phase.description: Where the capacity comes from ("": keep the load)

e2e.title: End to end
e2e.description: For repaired: also every cut-off router is in the border router's routing table and got an echo for a packet sent after the disruption (when it takes part in an echoed flow)

block_node_restart.title: Node restart
block_node_restart.description: Start the failed nodes again (fresh instances) under a share of the capacity, and measure until they are ready again and in the border router's routing table

use.title: Block
use.description: Start the failed nodes again (fresh instances) under a share of the capacity, and measure until they are ready again and in the border router's routing table

label.title: Label
label.description: The nodes of an earlier action

capacity_phase.title: Capacity phase
capacity_phase.description: Where the capacity comes from ("": keep the load)

block_capacity_check.title: Capacity again
block_capacity_check.description: A capacity search from a share of an earlier capacity (e.g. after a repair), against a fresh baseline: by default a probe of the network as it is now, then the search

use.title: Block
use.description: A capacity search from a share of an earlier capacity (e.g. after a repair), against a fresh baseline: by default a probe of the network as it is now, then the search

start_fraction.title: First rate
start_fraction.description: Share of the earlier capacity of the first step

baseline.title: Baseline
baseline.description: "self": a probe of its own first (<name>_probe); else an earlier phase

probe_s.title: Probe duration
probe_s.description: With baseline self: the probe's measured time

mul.title: Step factor
mul.description: Rate multiplied by this at each step

window_s.title: Window
window_s.description: Measured time of a step (longer when the rate gives too few packets)

settle_s.title: Settle
settle_s.description: Time at the new load before measuring

confirm.title: Confirm
confirm.description: The condition must hold on this many windows in a row at the same load

rtt_factor.title: RTT factor
rtt_factor.description: Saturated when the RTT reaches this x the baseline's

min_pdr.title: Delivery floor
min_pdr.description: Saturated when the delivery ratio falls below this

flows.title: Flows
flows.description: up: routers to border router; down: border router to each router; mcast: border router to a group; p2p: router to router. Up, down and p2p are echoed

selector.title: Nodes
selector.description: Which nodes an action acts on, resolved from the topology when the action runs

select.title: Selection
select.description: id: one node; ids: a list; all: every router; hop: the routers at a hop count; br_children: the border router's children (hop 1); ancestor: the node at a hop count on the path of a given node; storey or area: by position (needs a positions file); label: the nodes an earlier action picked

id.title: Node ID
id.description: For select id (0: the border router)

hop.title: Hop count
hop.description: For select hop and ancestor: hops to the border router

of.title: Of node
of.description: For select ancestor: the node whose path is taken

storey.title: Storey
storey.description: For select storey: the FLOOR of the positions file (else Z / 3.5 m)

box.title: Area
box.description: For select area: [x0, y0, x1, y1]

label.title: Label
label.description: For select label: the label of an earlier action

pick.title: Pick
pick.description: Among the candidates: all; largest_subtree or most_children (the worst case); random (drawn from the seed); fraction; first (lowest ID)

count.title: Count
count.description: How many to pick (largest_subtree, most_children, random, first)

fraction.title: Fraction
fraction.description: For pick fraction: the share of the candidates, drawn from the seed

allOf.x-message: select ancestor needs of and hop

relative.title: Relative to
relative.description: Factor x the same metric (or another one) measured in an earlier phase

metric.title: Metric
metric.description: The earlier phase's metric (default: the condition's metric); a capacity search also has capacity_pps

pdr.description: Delivery ratio of the flow: echoes received / requests sent; for multicast, receptions / (sends x members expected to receive)

latency.mean_ms.description: Mean one-way delay (send to reception at the target)

offered_pps.description: Packets sent per second by the flow (measured), whole network

delivered_pps.description: Packets delivered (echoed) per second, whole network

queue.mean_max.description: Highest mean queue depth of a node (MAC and adaptation layer) over the window

queue.now_max.description: Highest queue depth of a node at the end of the window

queue.drops.description: Packets dropped by full adaptation-layer queues (all nodes) in the window

mac.retries_per_frame.description: MAC retries per unicast frame delivered, whole network

mac.give_up.description: Unicast frames the MAC gave up (no ACK, channel access, other), all nodes, in the window

mac.cca_fail_rate.description: Channel-access failures / CCA attempts, whole network

mesh.joined_fraction.description: Routers with a route to the border router (parent chain)

mesh.orphans.description: Running routers without a route to the border router

mesh.parent_changes.description: Changes to a new parent seen in the window, all routers

power.avg_ma.description: Mean over the routers of their average current in the window (needs POWER)

medium.frames_per_s.description: Frames sent per second, whole network

medium.airtime_s_per_s.description: Airtime of every frame sent per second of the window (sum over all nodes)

medium.loss_share.description: Frames lost at receivers that were listening, over those heard (central medium)
